purpose: The systems the tautomer-boltzmann-v4 validation run is judged on that were NOT used to design v4 or to choose its method. Frozen BEFORE any v4 code was written and before any energy was computed for any of them.

selection_rule.text: A gas-phase tautomer set is eligible when (1) its reference is a single declared coupled-cluster-level (CCSD(T) or better, canonical or DLPNO) electronic-energy difference, no ZPE or thermal terms; (2) it has at most 12 heavy atoms; (3) every reference tautomer maps to exactly one enumerated tautomer by canonical non-isomeric SMILES (checked structurally, with no energy involved); (4) the source row is internally consistent: where a table carries a derived column, recomputing it must reproduce the printed value, and the structure-to-state map must not contradict the source's own table; (5) it comes from a source registered in docs/sources.toml. Every eligible system is taken. Difficulty, and any predicted or computed behaviour of any model on a system, play no part in selection. Where two eligible sources exist for one system the one with the higher declared level of theory is the reference and the other is recorded as corroboration.
selection_rule.applied_to: Goller 2022 Table 1 (molecules 1-5), Balabin 2009 Table III, and the supplementary papers listed per system below.

may_not_influence: conformer count, prune threshold, top-K, cap

corroboration.note: lower-level corroboration of sign and rough size only

excluded.reason: No eligible reference. Goller 2022 Table 1 (molecule 2: gas 8.70, water 1.06, printed DeltaDeltaE 7.78) fails its own check (8.70 - 1.06 = 7.64) and the supplied SI carries no CCSD(T) energies to settle it. The only other complete source, Hanus 2004 (RI-MP2/TZVPP; 7H 7.63 kcal/mol above 9H), is not coupled-cluster, so it fails criterion (1).
